attributes.residual: THREE OF TWELVE BRIEF PREMISES WERE REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT, which is the reason the reproduce-first rule exists. (1) Item 3 said wf_mkrule.py was broken because `_relocation_sha256` is called with one argument; it is not - `symbols` is optional and the empty relocation list never reaches the lookup. The real defect was a PROMOTION PATH bug (ROOT computed as HERE/.., two levels short), so the script died on ModuleNotFoundError before reaching any webfrank call. (2) Item 6 asked for `probe --rederive-pin` to drive the transient sequence in one call; it already does, verified end to end on game/ui/screensaver::end_inventory_panel (body build, guarded re-derive, configure.py, rebuild, webfrank.json unchanged). The real gap was DISCOVERABILITY at the moment of failure, so the refusal now names the repair. (3) Item 10 blamed insnband-only matches; the measured cause was different - 151 of 153 rows shared exactly one token, `b`, carried by 151 corpus signatures, while the 2 rows sharing `jumptable` sorted in among them. Both fixes shipped: the facet gate AND the rarity ranking. REMAINING QUEUE, now measured rather than guessed: 15 unpinned BOUNDARY refusals in webfrank.py (`python tools/gdl/composed_census/t8_refusal_coverage.py`), each needing a heavier fixture than the 11 closed this run.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Run fndiff.positional_reloc_rows over every non-game unit pair in build/GUNE5D/obj. If it reports zero WRONG_DATUM rows across the whole SDK/MSL surface, the idea is dead for one pass and the class is confined to game code.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: no - the sweep this run was deliberately scoped to game/ because that is where the reporting lane's evidence sat. The SDK/MSL side is unmeasured, which is precisely the claim.
hypothesis.statement: The positional relocation-identity pass has only been run over the game/ prefix (2040 paired functions, 2 WRONG_DATUM rows). Running it over the SDK and MSL prefixes, which are 100% matched and therefore never re-examined, should be free and may surface the same class: a wrong pool constant is invisible to every score those regions are judged by, and 'fully matched' is exactly the condition under which nobody looks again.
